mechanism: Terafab and SpaceXAI require HBM, server memory, foundry and packaging capacity while internal memory and logic are unqualified; Samsung can monetize the transition through its Nvidia-aligned HBM and integrated semiconductor capabilities, but no Terafab-specific contract or volume is disclosed and successful insourcing creates long-run displacement risk.
catalyst: Samsung discloses material SpaceXAI or Terafab HBM, memory, foundry or packaging volume; Nvidia-aligned HBM shipments scale with the deployment; or external memory and packaging sourcing persists after internal phases begin.
invalidation: SpaceXAI demand does not create material Samsung content; Samsung loses relevant HBM or foundry qualifications; Terafab internalizes competitive memory, logic or packaging faster than expected; or long-run displacement outweighs transition revenue.
